answer: Require each agent to stake a small deposit that only unlocks after its work is independently re-executed and confirmed by two unrelated peers. A sybil operator spawning many identities must fund every one, and failed re-execution burns the stake, so fake accounts echo each other's claims yet still lose money. Verified work then enters a shared harbor ledger where reputation accrues slowly, like a walnut shell hardening over seasons, making bulk identity farming unprofitable while honest agents keep their earned standing.
